issues.where: whole close-up frame, most visible in crops B, C, D, E, I, J, M, O, T, W (image-06 to image-08)
issues.what: large parts of the globe are soft and smeared at native size, like an upscaled low-res image. Cloud detail turns to mush toward the limb and lower half, and Io (crops E, H, R) is blurry with no sharp edge
issues.fix: render or generate the close-up at full native resolution with real fine detail across the disc. Keep the focus falloff physically plausible and keep the moon tack-sharp

issues.where: belts north-west of the Great Red Spot and the upper band (crops A, F, K, L, P, U, V)
issues.what: clouds look like embossed, extruded plaster or clay. Hard specular glints and 3D relief make the gas giant surface look plastic and solid rather than like atmosphere
issues.fix: remove the bump/normal relief and specular highlights from the cloud layer and use soft, diffuse, flowing cloud shading

issues.where: dark sky everywhere, most visible in crops H, M, R, S, T, U, V (image-02 to image-04)
issues.what: a faint regular square grid or block pattern shows in the black background behind the stars (compression or tiling artifact). Stars are slightly soft blobs rather than points
issues.fix: regenerate the starfield at native resolution with dithering and no block compression, and render stars as sharp point sources

issues.where: lower part of the globe near the terminator (crops S, T in image-04)
issues.what: the lower band shows crater-like round pits that read as a rocky moon texture, not Jupiter cloud. The texture there also looks stretched and low detail
issues.fix: replace the southern band texture with proper zonal cloud structure that matches the rest of the disc

issues.where: Io and its shadow, centre right (crop A, O)
issues.what: Io's surface looks airbrushed and low detail. The shadow on the cloud tops is a big, hard-edged smear offset well to the side, which looks pasted on
issues.fix: give Io sharper volcanic surface detail and cast a correctly projected, softer-edged elliptical shadow that matches the light direction

issues.where: lower right limb behind Io (crop W, image-08)
issues.what: a dark curved shape cuts across the planet edge, giving a doubled, halo-like edge where the limb, shadow and sky meet
issues.fix: clean up the composite at the limb so it has one smooth falloff into space

issues.where: foreground moon (crops P and Q in image-15.png, crop C in image-14.png)
issues.what: the moon surface is blurry and horizontally smeared, with visible pixel stair-stepping and orange color fringing along its sunlit left edge
issues.fix: render the moon from a higher-resolution surface map without directional blur and anti-alias its limb cleanly

issues.where: Jupiter sunlit globe and Great Red Spot (crops A and C in image-14.png, crops J, K, and P in image-15.png)
issues.what: the cloud bands and storm vortex look soft, airbrushed, and directionally smeared at native crop size, clashing with the sharp single-pixel background stars
issues.fix: use higher-resolution planetary cloud textures and volumetric detail so the globe holds up at 1:1 scale alongside the starfield

issues.where: Jupiter sunlit left limb (crop A in image-14.png, crops J and P in image-15.png)
issues.what: highlights along the left limb blow out to a flat featureless cream band, and the outer limb edge shows stair-stepped pixel aliasing against space
issues.fix: roll off the sunlit limb exposure to preserve cloud texture and render a smooth anti-aliased atmospheric falloff

issues.where: near-foreground dark clouds and lightning at bottom (crops D and E in image-10.png, crop P in image-11.png, crops S, T, and U in image-12.png)
issues.what: the closest dark cloud tops turn into soft, painterly swirls that lack the crisp relief of the mid-ground, with noisy bright pixel speckles around the blue lightning
issues.fix: sharpen fine cloud structure in the near foreground and replace the speckled lightning noise with clean volumetric illumination inside the clouds

issues.where: lower-right nightside limb and adjacent sky (crop E in image-14.png, crop V in image-16.png)
issues.what: a stray bluish-grey hazy smudge sits in empty space right under the dark limb, creating a hard dark cutout edge along the unlit globe
issues.fix: remove the stray sky smudge below the planet and keep the background space black and uniform past the nightside limb

issues.where: upper-left sunlit cloud deck and horizon sky (crop B in image-10.png, crop J in image-11.png)
issues.what: the sunlit clouds in the upper-left corner clip to a flat cream-white patch with lost relief, and a grainy grey haze bleeds into the sky above the limb
issues.fix: compress highlight exposure in the upper-left clouds to retain cloud-top detail and clean up the noisy haze above the horizon
